notes: Scope decisions: (1) file existence is checked directly via node:fs existsSync (repoFileExists), not injected through Fetchers -- gh calls are injected because they are network calls that must never hit real infra in a test; a filesystem read of the repo's own files is the same class of direct call loadIssues already makes, so it is not mocked. (2) An anchor's existence WITHIN its target file is not checked, only the target FILE's existence -- the brief's three failure modes name 'a file that does not exist', not a missing heading; documented as a scope line in absolutizeLinks's doc comment. (3) Link resolution's base directory is always the canonical docs/community/issues/<id>.md (backlogSourcePath), never the actual --issues-dir a run used (which can be a test fixture directory) -- this matches footerLine's pre-existing assumption and is what the real backlog's file:line-into-code links depend on.
